summary: The Context Plus Addressable loop powered Base Sounder with isolator is third-party certified to EN54-3 (Sounders) and 17 (Isolators) by the LPCB.
features: Supplied with a BF431QCP quick connect plate and detector spur wires.
Group addressing facility allows multiple devices to be operated simultaneously.
7 selectable volume levels and up to 15 selectable tone pairs.
Optional BF330CTLIDW white or BF330CTLIDR red cap available for stand-alone use.
